summary: Rule on the remaining qwen-3-4b-guru quarantine skip-pile (~15-20 cells) in guru-review
description: Across the four quarantine batches/waves correcting the v1->v2 regression's cross-tradition contamination, a handful of cells per wave were skipped rather than ruled on because the call was genuinely ambiguous (e.g. Kilhwch divine-transformation asides, a kalevala.044 maxim, a mooney.107 'go-to-water' cell). These accumulated to roughly 15-20 skipped cells sitting in guru-review's pending queue. No rush — the v3 retrain already shipped without them (see rellm's qwen-3-4b-guru v3 model card and 4b-v2-regression-root-cause project notes) — but they should get a ruling eventually so they don't just sit forever.
